limits: Each exact predeclared missing seed run once; no retry/reroll.
Each run branches from same genuine low30 inventory,145HP and fine weapon40; no tools granted. Owned Q/F chosen through public UI; G remains unused by driver.
Policy10 predeclared 2 search target but continuous exploration allows at most8 approach iterations; failures and overlong retreat retained.

Full static geometry is disclosed to macro-navigation. Enemy/Host/search selection uses observed records and paid survey display, not hidden rewards/enemy forecasts. Raw after-action state contains diagnostic loot information but was not selection input.
Concurrent behavioral runs; no timing/performance qualification derived.
Script success is distinct from game outcome. Deaths terminate QA during post-death export; frozen raw reports remain failed, production death checkpoint valid.
Normal frame review is one listed non-spawn action frame per run plus recorded actual inputs; not a claim that every frame or full world has been professionally playtested.
